LESSON: SAUM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Saum

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Saum
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why are some people exempted from fasting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the categories of people who are exempted from obligatory fast
2. explain the reasons for fidya (compensation) by people exempted from fasting during the month of Ramadhan
3. describe different ways of compensating for missed fasts
4. appreciate Allah (S.W.T.)’s mercy to Muslims for exemption of fasting with valid reasons
